one_line: Satavahana queen and regent who commemorated royal sacrifices and genealogy at Naneghat in the Western Ghats.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, poised and athletic with a dignified bearing
appearance.face: oval face with sharp cheekbones, warm medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, arched brows, large expressive anime-style eyes, a small beauty mark near the left cheek, default expression calm, confident and attentive
appearance.hair: rich black hair parted in the center, drawn back into a smooth high bun at the back of the head, wrapped with a narrow gold headband; a thin plait from each temple is looped over the headband and pinned above the ears
appearance.costume: era-accurate Deccan royal attire: a finely woven saffron-yellow cotton sari worn in early unstitched style, wrapped securely around the upper body covering the torso and draped over both shoulders, with the long end brought over the left shoulder and tucked at the waist; beneath it a full-length off-white cotton under-skirt; a fitted short-sleeved choli implied under the drape but fully covered; a deep red border with simple geometric bands runs along the sari edges; she wears multiple plain and beaded gold necklaces (one short collar, one longer reaching mid-chest), simple round gold earrings, a pair of gold armlets above the elbows, plain gold bangles on both wrists, and a narrow engraved gold waistband at the sari’s tie; her feet are in simple brown leather sandals suitable for the rocky pass
appearance.signature: a rolled palm-leaf manuscript secured with a thin cord, held confidently in her right hand and tucked slightly under her arm as a symbol of inscriptions and royal records

ref_desc: Queen Nayanika appears as a mid-30s Deccan queen with an oval medium-brown face, black hair in a high bun with gold headband, saffron-yellow red-bordered sari with gold jewellery, brown sandals, and a rolled palm-leaf manuscript in hand, using warm gold and deep red accents.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Queen Nayanika: a mid-30s Deccan queen with an oval medium-brown face, sharp cheekbones and large attentive eyes, black hair parted in the center and pulled into a smooth high bun wrapped by a narrow gold headband, with thin side plaits looped over the band. She wears a saffron-yellow cotton sari in an early unstitched style that modestly covers her torso and legs, wrapped firmly around the upper body and draped over both shoulders, with a deep red geometric border along all edges and the long end falling from her left shoulder and tucked at the waist over an off-white full-length underskirt; a choli is present but fully concealed by the drape. Adorn her with plain and beaded gold necklaces (short collar and longer chain), simple round gold earrings, gold armlets above the elbows, multiple gold bangles, and a narrow engraved gold waistband. Put simple brown leather sandals on her feet to suit the rocky Naneghat pass. In her right hand, have her hold a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a cord as her signature prop, close to her body in a confident yet composed pose. Use a palette dominated by saffron yellow, deep red, warm gold, off-white and brown, and keep the overall look historically grounded, regal and dignified.
